en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Sa’ad Bin Abu Khalaf, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> said to one of his<sup>asws</sup> children: ‘Beware of the laziness and the boredome, for these two would prevent you from your share of the world and the Hereafter’.
en.sarwar: 2. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from ibn Mahbub from Sa‘d ibn abu Khalaf from abu al-Hassan, Musa, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, Musa has said, ‘
My father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to a certain one of his sons, “Beware of laziness and impatience; these two can deprive you of your share in this world as well as in the hereafter.’””
